name: Falkirk Beginners 2026
information: ### This competition is targeted at **first-time competitors and less experienced competitors**, but everyone is welcome. ### While this competition is open to anyone to attend, **only competitors who have attended 2 or fewer competitions before will be eligible for medals**. PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Falkirk Open 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FalkirkOpen2026). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FalkirkBeginners2026#66385-series-competition-information). Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. **Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!** ### Falkirk Science Festival 2026 This competition is taking place with the kind support of the [Falkirk Science Festival](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FalkirkBeginners2026#66386-falkirk-science-festival-2026). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM1NTg2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2f94b2676d3ddf95a08d8423328a69db1fadac3e/Falkirk-Science-Fest-LOGO_N0_date.png) [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/) [![Speedcubing.org](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0Z0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ce316f12e822c022ffd1c75d1bdee86c94ccbc2d/image.png)](https://speedcubing.org/)
